senses.gloss: ch. sameto vouch for, be surety for.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 6:1">Targ. Prov. VI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 17:3">Targ. Job XVII, 3</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:8">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ</cite> top <he>אמרו ליה עוֹרְבָן ועַרְבוֹן וכ׳</he> they said to him, pledge thyself to us (that the mice will not attack our produces, if we separate the tithes properly, v. <cite ref="P01242">preced.</cite>), and he did pledge himself to them, and they suffered no longer (v. <cite ref="N00819"><he>נְכֵי</he></cite>). Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot <he>ריגלוי … עַרְבוּנֵיה למיקמתיה וכ׳</he> (not <he>ערבתיה</he>) man’s feet are pledged to place him where he is wanted (to die); <cite ref="Sukkah 53a:4">Succ. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>רגלוהי … אינון עַרְבִין ביה וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 48b:10">Bekh. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>מכדי נכסוהי … ערבין ביה</he> is a man’s property pledged for his personal debts (that you can seize it, even if it is sold)?; <cite ref="Bava Batra 174a:3">B. Bath. 174ᵃ</cite> <he>ניכסי</he> … <he>ערבין ביה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מערבין יתיה</he>) a man’s property is pledged for him (you can attach it without previous summons); a. e.
Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 40 (Bxt. עֲ׳ Pe.; Y. עַרְבֵּיב׳).
Targ. Y. I Deut. VII, 23 (ed. Vien. וִיעַרְבִּ׳ Pe.; Y. II ויערבב׳); a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 6a:18">Ḥull. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>כמאן דע׳ בידים דמי</he> it is as if he had mixed it (added leaven and spices) with his own hands.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39b:15">Ab. Zar. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא מייתי ומְעָרֵב ביה</he> lest he bring (unclean milk) and mix it with the clean milk; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02167"><he>מְעָרַב</he></cite>, <cite ref="M02167"><he>מְעַרַב</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְעַרְבִין</he>, <cite ref="M02171"><he>מְעַרְבֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 16:18">Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 18</cite> (not <he>מְעַרְבּ׳</he>, <cite ref="M00020"><he>מֵ׳</he></cite>).
Targ. Ex. XXX, 35 (ed. Vien. מַעֲרַב Af.) well-mixed, seasoned (h. text מְמֻלָּח).
Targ. Is. I, 22 (ed. Wil. מַעֲרָב Af.); a. e.—
Sabb. 85ᵇ והא קא מערבי להדי הדדי Ms. M. (ed. מִיתְעָרְבֵי בהדדי, Ithpa.) but will not the leaves of the seeds grow into each other?

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 16:5">Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 5</cite> <he>וִיעָ׳</he> (ed. Vien. <he>ויעַ׳</he>, corr. acc.).—Y. Bets. I, 61ᵇ top <he>אנשינן מְעָרְבָה</he> we forgot to make ʿErub Tabshilin (v. <cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>); a. e.

senses.gloss: to vouch, be surety. Part. pass. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 44:32">Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 32</cite> <cite ref="M02167"><he>מְעָרַב</he></cite> (not <cite ref="M02167"><he>מְעָרֵב</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 23:7">Targ. Josh. XXIII, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 7:3">Targ. Y. II, Deut. VII, 3</cite> (h. text <he>תתחתן</he>); a. e.—Sabb. l. c., v. supra.—Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>אי משום אִיעֲרוּבֵי</he> shall we apprehend an admixture (of wine in the honey)? <cite ref="Zevachim 76a:10">Zeb. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>סוף סוף איערובי מִיעֲרַב</he> at the end it is mixed up.

<cite ref="Zevachim 76a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>דאיע׳</he> when it became mixed; <cite ref="Zevachim 75b">ib. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>דאִיעֲרוּב</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דאיעבד</he>) when things have become mixed; a. e.—[Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>ולא מיערב</he>, read <cite ref="M02167"><he>מְעָרֵב</he></cite>.]
